original_question:
Write Verilog HDL code for the following two modules:

1.  A module named `FullAdder` that implements a single-bit full adder. It should have the following interface:
    *   Inputs: `a`, `b`, `cin` (all 1-bit)
    *   Outputs: `sum`, `cout` (all 1-bit)
    This module takes two input bits and a carry-in bit and produces their sum bit and a carry-out bit.

2.  A module named `Adder4` that implements a 4-bit ripple-carry adder. It should have the following interface:
    *   Inputs: `A`, `B` (both 4-bit vectors), `Cin` (1-bit)
    *   Outputs: `S` (4-bit vector), `Cout` (1-bit)
    This module takes two 4-bit binary numbers (`A` and `B`) and a carry-in bit (`Cin`), and produces their 4-bit sum (`S`) and a carry-out bit (`Cout`). You should implement this 4-bit adder by instantiating four instances of the `FullAdder` module you defined previously and connecting them appropriately to form a ripple-carry chain.

Your code should include both module definitions.
